task.title: Adding keys to the PostgreSQL database
task.shortdesc: To register read-only service keys with Red Hat Quay, you can insert the key and approval records into the PostgreSQL database.

ul.li: You have created the service keys.

step.cmd: Enter the following command to enter your Red Hat Quay database environment:

info.codeblock: $ podman exec -it postgresql-quay psql -U postgres -d quay

step.cmd: Display the approval types and associated notes of the servicekeyapproval by entering the following command:

info.codeblock: id | approver_id | approval_type | approved_date | notes ----+-------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------+------- 1 | | ServiceKeyApprovalType.AUTOMATIC | 2024-05-07 03:47:48.181347 | 2 | | ServiceKeyApprovalType.AUTOMATIC | 2024-05-07 03:47:55.808087 | 3 | | ServiceKeyApprovalType.AUTOMATIC | 2024-05-07 03:49:04.27095 | 4 | | ServiceKeyApprovalType.AUTOMATIC | 2024-05-07 03:49:05.46235 | 5 | 1 | ServiceKeyApprovalType.SUPERUSER | 2024-05-07 04:05:10.296796 | ...

step.cmd: Add the service key to your Red Hat Quay database by entering the following query:

info.codeblock: quay=# INSERT INTO servicekey (name, service, metadata, kid, jwk, created_date, expiration_date) VALUES ('quay-readonly', 'quay', '{}', '<contents_of_.kid_file>', '<contents_of_.jwk_file>', '<created_date_of_read-only>', '<expiration_date_of_read-only>');
